source.title: Optogenetic stimulation of a cortical biohybrid implant guides goal directed behavior

material: SU-8 microwell scaffold on fused silica bonded to glass coverslip, loaded with primary cortical neurons (biohybrid implant)

formulation.evidence: 0.1 mg/mL poly-d-Lysine (Gibco) and 0.1 mg/mL Laminin (Millipore Sigma, L2020) in DI water
0.1 mg/mL poly-d-Lysine (Gibco) and 0.1 mg/mL Laminin (Millipore Sigma, L2020) in DI water
Cell concentration was counted and adjusted to 1e6

processing.evidence: exposed to O2 plasma in a Technics RIE for 2 minutes at 50W
SU-8 2010 photoresist (Kayaku) was spun at 3000 rpm
for 30 seconds, soft-baked at 95℃ for 3.5 minutes on a hotplate
for 30 seconds, soft-baked at 95℃ for 3.5 minutes on a hotplate
for 30 seconds, soft-baked at 95℃ for 3.5 minutes on a hotplate
developed for 3.5 minutes in SU-8 Developer

a UV flood-exposure was used with a total UV energy
of ~1.86 J
hard baked by holding at 95℃ for 5 minutes
ramping to 200℃ for 2 minutes on a hotplate
cured in an oven at 65℃ for 2 hours
centrifuged at 300 RCF for 5 minutes at room temperature

description.value: no visible structural deterioration of microwell scaffold
description.evidence:
no visible sign of
structural deterioration of the microwell scaffold even months after implantation

stability.conditions: in vivo, implanted on mouse cortex

biology.cell_type: primary embryonic cortical neurons (E14.5-E15.5), AAV-transduced (CheRiff-eGFP / jRGECO1a)

other_outcomes.evidence: on average we filled 77±15% (mean ± s.d., n=23 microwell scaffolds
other_outcomes.name: microwell loading fraction 24 h after loading

other_outcomes.evidence:
we found 52±23% (mean±s.d.) of microwells to be
loaded with neurons expressing fluorescent protein
other_outcomes.name: fraction of microwells with fluorescent neurons 3 weeks after implantation

notes: Microwells: 10 µm diameter, 15 µm deep, 15 µm pitch hexagonal lattice, ~1.18 x 10^5 microwells over 25 mm2. Implanted on cortical surface after craniectomy/duratomy in C57/B6J mice; spontaneous calcium activity observed 3 weeks after implantation; 5 of 9 biohybrid mice reached behavioral criterion.
